question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. **

ROYAL
solution: The correct answer is '**Kingly**'. ***__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Royal**' is '**Kingly**'. • **Royal**: connected with a king or queen or a member of their family. [राजकीय, शाही (राजा या रानी या राजपरिवार से संबंधित)] • *Example: The princess lives in a **royal** castle.* • **Kingly**: associated with or typical of a king; regal. (एक राजा के साथ जुड़ा या विशिष्ट; शाही) • *Example: He was the first of Rome's **kingly** vassals.* **Correct Answer:__** Kingly.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Minor**: not very big, serious, or important (when compared with others). [जो अधिक बड़ा, गंभीर या आवश्‍यक न हो (औरों की तुलना में), गौण, छोटा, कम महत्वपूर्ण] • **Poorly**: in an unsatisfactory, inadequate, or unsuccessful way. (असंतोषजनक, अपर्याप्त या असफल तरीके से) • **Lowly**: low in status or importance; humble. (स्थिति या महत्व में कम; विनीत) 41:T538, The correct answer is** 'To become very excited or angry'.**
